title: Yellowstone National Park
summary: Yellowstone, set up by the U.S. Congress on March 1, 1872, is generally regarded as the world's first national park. It lies mainly in northwestern Wyoming, with parts in Montana and Idaho, and holds the world's largest concentration of geysers and hydrothermal features. It later gained UNESCO biosphere reserve and World Heritage status.
